### change-policy.d.ts
import { type BuildConfigDiffOptions, type ConfigDiff } from "./diff.js";
import type { ConfigPath, ConfigResult } from "./types.js";
export type ConfigChangeRule = {
    readonly id: string;
    readonly path: ConfigPath;
} & ({
    readonly mode: "forbid-changes" | "require-path";
} | {
    readonly mode: "allowed-sources";
    readonly allowedSourceIds: readonly string[];
});
export interface ConfigChangePolicy {
    readonly version: "change-policy-1";
    readonly rules: readonly ConfigChangeRule[];
}
export interface ConfigPolicyViolation {
    readonly code: "change_forbidden" | "required_path_missing" | "source_not_allowed" | "comparison_indeterminate" | "invalid_policy" | "comparison_failed" | "max_report_bytes_exceeded";
    readonly ruleId?: string;
    readonly path?: ConfigPath;
}
export interface ConfigChangeCheck {
    readonly schemaVersion: "change-check-1";
    readonly status: "ok" | "error";
    readonly diff: ConfigDiff;
    readonly policy: {
        readonly status: "passed" | "failed" | "error";
        readonly violations: readonly ConfigPolicyViolation[];
    };
}
/** Policy always evaluates the complete configuration; a query cannot hide changes. */
export declare function checkConfigChanges(before: ConfigResult, after: ConfigResult, policy: unknown, options?: Omit<BuildConfigDiffOptions, "path">): ConfigChangeCheck;

### diff.d.ts
import { type BuildConfigInspectionOptions, type ConfigInspection, type ConfigInspectionEntry } from "./inspection.js";
import type { ConfigPath, ConfigResult, ConfigValue } from "./types.js";
export type ConfigChangeKind = "added" | "removed" | "type-changed" | "value-changed" | "source-changed";
export interface ConfigChange {
    readonly path: ConfigPath;
    readonly kinds: readonly ConfigChangeKind[];
    readonly before?: ConfigInspectionEntry;
    readonly after?: ConfigInspectionEntry;
}
export interface BuildConfigDiffOptions extends BuildConfigInspectionOptions {
    /** Explicitly disclose secret-change metadata; never retains values or fingerprints. */
    readonly detectSecretChanges?: boolean;
}
export interface ConfigDiff {
    readonly schemaVersion: "diff-1";
    readonly status: "ok" | "error";
    readonly secretComparison: "skipped" | "detected";
    readonly uncomparedSecretPaths: readonly ConfigPath[];
    readonly changes: readonly ConfigChange[];
    readonly before: ConfigInspection;
    readonly after: ConfigInspection;
    readonly error?: "input_failed" | "max_diff_entries_exceeded" | "max_report_bytes_exceeded";
}
export declare function buildConfigDiff(before: ConfigResult, after: ConfigResult, options?: BuildConfigDiffOptions): ConfigDiff;
/** Iterative and order-insensitive for objects; arrays retain positional semantics. */
export declare function configValuesEqual(left: ConfigValue, right: ConfigValue): boolean;
/** Internal shared failure envelope for comparison and policy byte budgets. */
export declare function diffFailure(base: ConfigDiff, error: NonNullable<ConfigDiff["error"]>, maxBytes: number): ConfigDiff;

### inspection.d.ts
import { type BuildDiagnosticReportOptions } from "./redaction.js";
import type { ConfigPath, ConfigResult, ConfigScalar, ConfigValue, DiagnosticReport, DiagnosticReportResolvedPath } from "./types.js";
export type InspectedValueType = "null" | "string" | "number" | "boolean" | "object" | "array";
export interface ConfigInspectionEntry {
    readonly path: ConfigPath;
    readonly type: InspectedValueType;
    readonly visibility: "visible" | "redacted" | "container";
    readonly value?: ConfigScalar;
    readonly truncated?: boolean;
    readonly redactionReason?: string;
    readonly source?: DiagnosticReportResolvedPath;
}
export interface BuildConfigInspectionOptions extends BuildDiagnosticReportOptions {
    readonly path?: ConfigPath;
    /** Preview characters only; diff always compares the complete original value. */
    readonly maxValueLength?: number;
}
export interface ConfigInspection {
    readonly schemaVersion: "inspection-1";
    readonly status: "ok" | "error";
    readonly found: boolean;
    readonly path: ConfigPath;
    readonly entries: readonly ConfigInspectionEntry[];
    readonly diagnostics: DiagnosticReport;
}
export declare function buildConfigInspection(result: ConfigResult, options?: BuildConfigInspectionOptions): ConfigInspection;
export declare function configValueType(value: ConfigValue): InspectedValueType;

### public-report.d.ts
import type { ConfigIssueCategory, DiagnosticReport, ProvenanceAction, SourceKind } from "./types.js";
export interface PublicDiagnosticReport {
    readonly schemaVersion: "public-diagnostic-1";
    readonly status: "ok" | "error";
    readonly sources: readonly {
        readonly id: string;
        readonly kind: SourceKind | "other";
        readonly status: "loaded" | "failed";
    }[];
    readonly resolvedPaths: readonly {
        readonly path: string;
        readonly winningSource: string;
        readonly overriddenSources: readonly string[];
        readonly redacted: boolean;
    }[];
    readonly issues: readonly {
        readonly category: ConfigIssueCategory | "other";
        readonly severity: "error" | "warning";
        readonly source?: string;
        readonly path?: string;
    }[];
    readonly provenance: readonly {
        readonly action: ProvenanceAction | "other";
        readonly source: string;
        readonly previousSource?: string;
        readonly path: string;
    }[];
    readonly truncated?: true;
}
/** Allowlist projection: never retain arbitrary strings, values, names, paths or prose. */
export declare function buildPublicDiagnosticReport(report: DiagnosticReport): PublicDiagnosticReport;

### resolved-path-index.d.ts
import type { ConfigPath, SourceLocation } from "./types.js";
import type { FlattenedConfigEntry } from "./value.js";
export interface MutableResolvedPath {
    path: ConfigPath;
    status: "resolved";
    winningSourceId: string;
    winningPriority: number;
    overriddenSourceIds: string[];
    winningLocation?: SourceLocation;
    overriddenLocations: SourceLocation[];
}
export interface MutableResolvedPathIndex {
    readonly byPath: Map<string, MutableResolvedPath>;
    readonly root: ResolvedPathTrieNode;
}
interface ResolvedPathTrieNode {
    readonly children: Map<string, ResolvedPathTrieNode>;
    entryKey?: string;
}
export declare function synchronizeCoercedResolvedPaths(index: MutableResolvedPathIndex, entries: readonly FlattenedConfigEntry[]): void;
export declare function findRelatedResolvedPaths(resolvedIndex: MutableResolvedPathIndex, path: ConfigPath): readonly {
    readonly key: string;
    readonly resolved: MutableResolvedPath;
}[];
export declare function createResolvedPathIndex(): MutableResolvedPathIndex;
export declare function setResolvedPath(index: MutableResolvedPathIndex, resolved: MutableResolvedPath): void;
export declare function deleteResolvedPath(index: MutableResolvedPathIndex, key: string): void;
export {};

### standard-schema.d.ts
import type { ValidatorAdapter } from "./types.js";
/** Structural Standard Schema v1 compatibility; no provider/runtime dependency. */
export interface StandardConfigSchema<TOutput = unknown> {
    readonly "~standard": {
        readonly version: 1;
        readonly vendor: string;
        readonly validate: (value: unknown) => StandardConfigSchemaResult<TOutput> | Promise<StandardConfigSchemaResult<TOutput>>;
        readonly types?: {
            readonly input: unknown;
            readonly output: TOutput;
        } | undefined;
    };
}
export interface StandardConfigSchemaIssue {
    readonly message: string;
    readonly path?: readonly (PropertyKey | {
        readonly key: PropertyKey;
    })[] | undefined;
}
export type StandardConfigSchemaResult<TOutput> = {
    readonly value: TOutput;
    readonly issues?: undefined;
} | {
    readonly issues: readonly StandardConfigSchemaIssue[];
};
export type StandardConfigSchemaOutput<TSchema extends StandardConfigSchema> = TSchema extends StandardConfigSchema<infer TOutput> ? TOutput : never;
export interface CreateStandardSchemaValidatorInput<TOutput = unknown> {
    readonly schema: StandardConfigSchema<TOutput>;
    readonly id?: string;
    /** Defaults to maxDiagnostics (200), with a hard cap of 10,000. */
    readonly maxIssues?: number;
}
export declare function createStandardSchemaValidator<TOutput>(input: CreateStandardSchemaValidatorInput<TOutput>): ValidatorAdapter<TOutput>;

### typed-pipeline.d.ts
import { type RunConfigPipelineInput, type RunConfigPipelineResult } from "./pipeline.js";
import type { ValidatorAdapter } from "./types.js";
export interface RunValidatedConfigPipelineInput<TOutput, TContext = undefined> extends RunConfigPipelineInput<TContext> {
    readonly outputValidator: ValidatorAdapter<TOutput>;
}
export type RunValidatedConfigPipelineResult<TOutput> = RunConfigPipelineResult & ({
    readonly ok: true;
    readonly value: TOutput;
} | {
    readonly ok: false;
    readonly value?: never;
});
/** Return schema output separately; resolved config and its provenance stay unchanged. */
export declare function runValidatedConfigPipeline<TOutput, TContext = undefined>(input: RunValidatedConfigPipelineInput<TOutput, TContext>): Promise<RunValidatedConfigPipelineResult<TOutput>>;

### types.d.ts
export type ConfigScalar = string | number | boolean | null;
export type ConfigValue = ConfigScalar | readonly ConfigValue[] | {
    readonly [key: string]: ConfigValue;
};
export type ConfigPathSegment = string | number;
export type ConfigPath = readonly ConfigPathSegment[];
export type SourceKind = "defaults" | "object" | "json-file" | "dotenv-file" | "process-env" | "argv" | "adapter";
export interface RedactionPolicyInput {
    readonly secretSource?: boolean;
    readonly secretPaths?: readonly ConfigPath[];
    readonly secretNamePatterns?: readonly string[];
}
export interface ConfigSourceDescriptor {
    readonly id: string;
    readonly kind: SourceKind;
    readonly priority: number;
    readonly displayName: string;
    readonly redaction?: RedactionPolicyInput;
}
export interface SourceLocation {
    readonly sourceId: string;
    readonly sourcePath?: string;
    readonly line?: number;
    readonly column?: number;
}
export interface ValueLocation {
    readonly path: ConfigPath;
    readonly location: SourceLocation;
}
export type ConfigIssueCategory = "usage" | "source-load" | "parse" | "mapping" | "merge" | "coercion" | "validation" | "redaction" | "resource-limit";
export type ConfigIssueSeverity = "error" | "warning";
export interface ConfigIssue {
    readonly category: ConfigIssueCategory;
    readonly code: string;
    readonly severity: ConfigIssueSeverity;
    readonly message: string;
    readonly path?: ConfigPath;
    readonly sourceId?: string;
    readonly details?: Readonly<Record<string, string | number | boolean | null>>;
}
export interface LoadedSource {
    readonly descriptor: ConfigSourceDescriptor;
    readonly value: unknown;
    readonly locations?: readonly ValueLocation[];
    readonly issues?: readonly ConfigIssue[];
}
export interface ConfigLoaderResult {
    readonly value: unknown;
    readonly locations?: readonly ValueLocation[];
    readonly issues?: readonly ConfigIssue[];
}
export interface ConfigLoader<TContext = undefined> {
    readonly descriptor: ConfigSourceDescriptor;
    load(context: TContext): Promise<ConfigLoaderResult> | ConfigLoaderResult;
}
export type ProvenanceAction = "defined" | "overridden" | "defaulted" | "coerced" | "validated" | "redacted" | "rejected";
export interface ProvenanceEvent {
    readonly path: ConfigPath;
    readonly action: ProvenanceAction;
    readonly sourceId: string;
    readonly previousSourceId?: string;
    readonly message: string;
}
export interface MergePolicy {
    readonly objectPolicy: "deep-merge";
    readonly arrayPolicy: "replace";
    readonly scalarPolicy: "higher-priority-replaces";
    readonly nullPolicy: "explicit-null-overwrites";
    readonly unsafeKeyPolicy: "reject";
    readonly samePriorityPolicy: "issue-and-later-source-wins";
}
export interface ResourceLimitPolicy {
    readonly maxDepth: number;
    readonly maxKeyCount: number;
    readonly maxPathLength: number;
    readonly maxDiagnostics: number;
    readonly maxSources: number;
    readonly maxProvenanceEvents: number;
    readonly maxResolvedPaths: number;
    readonly maxReportBytes: number;
}
export interface OverrideMapping {
    readonly externalName: string;
    readonly targetPath: ConfigPath;
    readonly sourceKind: "process-env" | "argv";
    readonly parseAs?: "string" | "number" | "boolean" | "json";
    readonly secret?: boolean;
}
export interface CoercionRule {
    readonly path: ConfigPath;
    readonly from: "string";
    readonly to: "number" | "boolean" | "json";
    readonly onFailure: "issue";
}
export interface ValidatorInput {
    readonly config: ConfigValue;
    readonly provenance: readonly ProvenanceEvent[];
}
export interface ValidatorIssue {
    /** ASCII machine identifier, at most 128 characters. */
    readonly code: string;
    readonly severity: ConfigIssueSeverity;
    readonly path?: ConfigPath;
}
export interface ValidatorResult<TValidated = unknown> {
    readonly ok: boolean;
    /**
     * Adapter-local typed output. Core validation records issues and provenance only;
     * it does not replace pipeline config with this value.
     */
    readonly value?: TValidated;
    readonly issues: readonly ValidatorIssue[];
}
export interface ValidatorAdapter<TValidated = unknown> {
    readonly id: string;
    validate(input: ValidatorInput): Promise<ValidatorResult<TValidated>> | ValidatorResult<TValidated>;
}
export interface ResolvedPath {
    readonly path: ConfigPath;
    readonly status: "resolved";
    readonly winningSourceId: string;
    readonly winningPriority: number;
    readonly overriddenSourceIds: readonly string[];
    readonly winningLocation?: SourceLocation;
    readonly overriddenLocations?: readonly SourceLocation[];
}
export interface ResolveConfigInput {
    readonly sources: readonly LoadedSource[];
    readonly mergePolicy?: Partial<MergePolicy>;
    readonly limits?: Partial<ResourceLimitPolicy>;
    readonly coercionRules?: readonly CoercionRule[];
}
export interface ConfigResult {
    readonly ok: boolean;
    readonly config: ConfigValue;
    readonly sources: readonly ConfigSourceDescriptor[];
    readonly issues: readonly ConfigIssue[];
    readonly provenance: readonly ProvenanceEvent[];
    readonly resolvedPaths: readonly ResolvedPath[];
    readonly limits: ResourceLimitPolicy;
}
export interface DiagnosticReportSource {
    readonly id: string;
    readonly kind: SourceKind;
    readonly displayName: string;
    readonly priority: number;
    readonly status: "loaded" | "failed";
}
export interface DiagnosticReportResolvedPath {
    readonly path: ConfigPath;
    readonly status: "resolved";
    readonly winningSourceId: string;
    readonly overriddenSourceIds: readonly string[];
    readonly winningLocation?: SourceLocation;
    readonly overriddenLocations?: readonly SourceLocation[];
    readonly redacted: boolean;
    readonly redactionReason?: string;
}
export interface DiagnosticReport {
    readonly schemaVersion: "0.2";
    readonly status: "ok" | "error";
    readonly sources: readonly DiagnosticReportSource[];
    readonly resolvedPaths: readonly DiagnosticReportResolvedPath[];
    readonly issues: readonly ConfigIssue[];
    readonly provenance: readonly ProvenanceEvent[];
    readonly limits: ResourceLimitPolicy;
}

### file-source.d.ts
import type { ConfigIssue, ConfigSourceDescriptor, LoadedSource } from "@0disoft/universal-config-engine-core";

interface FileSourceInput extends FileReadPolicy {

} | {
    readonly ok: false;
    readonly issues: readonly ConfigIssue[];
};
export declare function readTextFileWithinLimit(input: {
    readonly filePath: string;
    readonly sourceId: string;
    readonly maxFileBytes?: number;
    readonly encoding?: BufferEncoding;
    readonly allowedRootPath?: string;
}): Promise<BoundedTextFileReadResult>;
export declare function checkFileSize(input: {
    readonly filePath: string;
    readonly sourceId: string;
    readonly maxFileBytes?: number;
}): Promise<readonly ConfigIssue[]>;

### reload.d.ts
import { type RunConfigPipelineResult } from "@0disoft/universal-config-engine-core";
export type ReloadFailure = "load_failed" | "validation_failed" | "snapshot_failed" | "closed";
export type ConfigReloadOutcome = {
    readonly ok: true;
    readonly revision: number;
    readonly snapshot: RunConfigPipelineResult;
} | {
    readonly ok: false;
    readonly revision: number;
    readonly reason: ReloadFailure;
};
export interface ConfigReloadEvent {
    readonly status: "updated" | "rejected";
    readonly revision: number;
    readonly reason?: ReloadFailure | "watch_failed";
    /** Counts public changes only; absent when comparison cannot fit its budget. */
    readonly changedPathCount?: number;
}
export interface CreateConfigReloaderInput {
    readonly load: () => Promise<RunConfigPipelineResult>;
    readonly onChange?: (event: ConfigReloadEvent) => void | Promise<void>;
}
export interface ConfigReloader {
    /** An active refresh and at most one queued refresh; bursts share that queue. */
    refresh(): Promise<ConfigReloadOutcome>;
    getSnapshot(): RunConfigPipelineResult | undefined;
    close(): void;
}
/** No automatic work starts until refresh is explicitly called. */
export declare function createConfigReloader(input: CreateConfigReloaderInput): ConfigReloader;
/** Internal notification boundary shared with the filesystem watcher. */
export declare function createReloadState(input: CreateConfigReloaderInput): {
    controller: ConfigReloader;
    watchFailed: () => void;
};

### watch.d.ts
import { type ConfigReloader, type ConfigReloadOutcome, type CreateConfigReloaderInput } from "./reload.js";
export interface WatchConfigFilesInput extends CreateConfigReloaderInput {
    readonly workspacePath: string;
    readonly paths: readonly string[];
    readonly debounceMs?: number;
}
export type WatchConfigFilesResult = {
    readonly ok: true;
    readonly watcher: ConfigReloader;
    readonly initial: ConfigReloadOutcome;
} | {
    readonly ok: false;
    readonly code: "watch_input_invalid" | "watch_path_outside_workspace" | "watch_setup_failed";
};
/** Watches selected basenames in their parent directories, including atomic replacements. */
export declare function watchConfigFiles(input: WatchConfigFilesInput): Promise<WatchConfigFilesResult>;

### types.d.ts
import type { CoercionRule, ConfigSourceDescriptor, OverrideMapping, ResourceLimitPolicy } from "@0disoft/universal-config-engine-core";
import type { Schema } from "ajv/dist/ajv.js";
import type { ConfigFileFormat, UnmappedInputBehavior } from "@0disoft/universal-config-engine-node";
export type CliCommand = "explain" | "validate";
export type CliExecutionCommand = CliCommand | "diff";
export type CliOutputMode = "human" | "json";
export interface PipelineDeclaration {
    readonly sources: readonly PipelineSourceDeclaration[];
    readonly validators?: readonly PipelineValidatorDeclaration[];
    readonly coercionRules?: readonly CoercionRule[];
    readonly limits?: Partial<ResourceLimitPolicy>;
    readonly profiles?: Readonly<Record<string, PipelineProfileDeclaration>>;
    readonly extends?: readonly string[];
}
export interface PipelineProfileDeclaration {
    readonly sources?: readonly PipelineSourceDeclaration[];
    readonly validators?: readonly PipelineValidatorDeclaration[];
    readonly coercionRules?: readonly CoercionRule[];
    readonly limits?: Partial<ResourceLimitPolicy>;
}
export type PipelineSourceDeclaration = ObjectSourceDeclaration | JsonFileSourceDeclaration | FileAdapterSourceDeclaration | DotenvFileSourceDeclaration | ProcessEnvSourceDeclaration | ArgvSourceDeclaration;
interface BaseSourceDeclaration {
    readonly id: string;
    readonly priority: number;
    readonly displayName?: string;
    readonly redaction?: ConfigSourceDescriptor["redaction"];
}
export interface ObjectSourceDeclaration extends BaseSourceDeclaration {
    readonly kind: "object";
    readonly value: unknown;
}
export interface JsonFileSourceDeclaration extends BaseSourceDeclaration {
    readonly kind: "json-file";
    readonly path: string;
    readonly maxFileBytes?: number;
}
export interface DotenvFileSourceDeclaration extends BaseSourceDeclaration {
    readonly kind: "dotenv-file";
    readonly path: string;
    readonly maxFileBytes?: number;
}
export interface FileAdapterSourceDeclaration extends BaseSourceDeclaration {
    readonly kind: "adapter";
    readonly format: ConfigFileFormat;
    readonly path: string;
    readonly maxFileBytes?: number;
    readonly allowTrailingComma?: boolean;
}
export interface ProcessEnvSourceDeclaration extends BaseSourceDeclaration {
    readonly kind: "process-env";
    readonly mappings: readonly OverrideMapping[];
    readonly maxEnvEntries?: number;
    readonly unmappedBehavior?: UnmappedInputBehavior;
    readonly unmappedPrefix?: string;
}
export interface ArgvSourceDeclaration extends BaseSourceDeclaration {
    readonly kind: "argv";
    readonly mappings: readonly OverrideMapping[];
    readonly maxArgvEntries?: number;
    readonly unmappedBehavior?: UnmappedInputBehavior;
}
export interface AjvJsonSchemaValidatorDeclaration {
    readonly id: string;
    readonly kind: "json-schema-ajv";
    readonly schema: Schema;
}
export interface PipelineValidatorDeclaration {
    readonly id: string;
    readonly kind: string;
    readonly schema?: unknown;
}
export interface CliRuntime {
    readonly cwd: string;
    readonly env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv;
    readonly stdout: (text: string) => void;
    readonly stderr: (text: string) => void;
}
export interface CliResult {
    readonly exitCode: number;
}
export {};
